answer: Each identity must lock tokens plus a per-epoch fee; a falcon watcher randomly challenges identities, and any proven duplicate loses the entire bond, split between challenger and treasury. Sybil resistance comes from staking a bonded deposit into a shared vault prior to an agent may vote. Honest agents recover their stake and an onyx reward token after the epoch closes cleanly, so faking identities costs far more than one honest stake per vote.
